profile.subject: a grey tabby cat
profile.styleHints: grey tabby coat with dark stripes, ringed black-tipped tail, green eyes, large upright ears

cycle.prompt: Same grey tabby cat with dark stripes and ringed tail in strict side profile facing right, one green eye visible, walking quadruped gait, 4-frame sequence showing legs alternating, tail slightly swaying, same size in every frame, 4 equal columns with wide magenta gaps, horizontal sprite sheet

profile.idlePrompt: Pose: standing alert in side view facing right, four paws grounded, tail extended back, head up with ears forward

rest.label: Sit & Rest
rest.prompt: Pose: sitting upright with front paws together, tail curled around side, head facing right, calm relaxed posture

sleep.label: Curl Up
sleep.prompt: Pose: curled in a tight loaf with tail over nose, eyes closed, paws tucked under chest

voice.label: Meow
voice.prompt: Pose: standing with head tilted up right, mouth open mid-meow, tail upright, ears forward

trick.label: Knead Biscuits
trick.prompt: Pose: standing with front paws alternately kneading in air, head tilted, tail raised high with happy arch

lines: Hi hi! I'm Mochi, let's play!
Did you call my name? I'm here!
Look at my stripy tail, whee!
I'm curious, what's that over there?
Pick me up for zoomies time!
Stay with me, I'm your buddy!

facts.text: Egyptian Maus are the only naturally spotted pet cats in the world.
They can run up to 30 miles per hour, the fastest pet cat.
They can jump six feet high from a standstill.
